summary: Angle bays in front of Graceville shops; fine overnight but in view of homes.
reasons: Angle bays tight for a 7 m van

drivers.seclusion: Shop frontage behind; a house to the west about 19 m and houses across Bank Road about 30 m south, all in view of the bays.
drivers.access_and_room: Open kerbside angle bays off Bank Road; a van longer than the bay will overhang into the lane.
drivers.traffic: Village centre with passing traffic and a rail line to the east.
drivers.convention: Time-limited signs run to 9 pm on weekdays (1/4P and 1P); nothing restricts overnight, and the bays are full of cars by day.

flags: Signs: 1/4P to 9 pm and 1P to 6 pm Mon-Fri, 2P parallel nearby; none overnight
No Stopping Any Time sign at the corner, keep clear
Noise: rail line and road traffic
Bays are short for a van up to 7.5 m
sun_shade: Open to the sun; the shop roof shades the bays in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether shops or residents mind overnight vans

best_section.where: Angle bays along the shop frontage on Bank Road, east of the side lane
